title: Public Law 119-50: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule…
summary: H.J.Res. 106, "Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to "Central Yukon Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan".", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-50 on 2025-12-11, according to Congress.gov.
